info.about: Saw II: Flesh & Blood is a survival horror game developed by Zombie Studios and published by Konami for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. It is the second video game in the Saw franchise, following 2009's Saw: The Video Game.
info.trivia: It was released in October 2010 to coincide with the seventh film, Saw 3D, and is set between the first two films.
